{"metadata":{"description":"一个可以管理皮肤的dsh插件","id":"gh:1334951659","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-skin-manager","slug":"xiaoyangcheng84-svg/dsh-skin-manager","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-skin-manager"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A lightweight **skin manager** for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. It discovers
every installed skin ("},{"id":"p3s2","text":"any package carrying a `skin.json` plus a prebuilt
client bundle), lists them in a dedicated **Setti"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ngs → Skins** page, and lets
you switch the active skin with one click — mutually exclusive, hot-rel"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"oaded
without restarting `dsh web`."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Dynamic discovery** — scans the web profile's `node_modules` for packages
with `skin.json` + pre"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"built `lib/client.js`, and also recognizes market
themes without `skin.json` (a client bundle plus a"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" `cordis.patch.yml` that
inserts a theme/skin loader row, e.g. `dsh-skin` / Codex-style skin or
`dsh"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"-kimino-theme`). Newly installed skins appear automatically; no registry
regeneration, no code chang"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"es.
- **Dedicated settings page** — a `settings.section` entry (id `skins`,
order 20) in the setting"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"s sidebar, next to General / Models.
- **One-click apply** — pick a skin and click **Apply**; the pr"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"ofile patch is
rewritten and DSH's config watcher hot-reloads it within seconds. Refresh
the page to"},{"id":"p5s8","text":" activate.
- **Mutually exclusive** — exactly one skin is active at a time (the active
one gets an `"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"insert` row, every other skin a `disabled: true` row).
- **Restore default** — the **Default** optio"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"n disables every skin and returns
to the stock DeepSeek Harness appearance."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web` (or rely on the market's hot install). Open
**Settings → Skins** after a page"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"art `dsh web` (or rely on the market's hot install). Open
**Settings → Skins** after a page refresh."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> Requires git for the `github:` source install; alternatively install from a
> local checkout with "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"`dsh plugin --profile web add link:<path>`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. Open **Settings → Skins**.
2. See **Default** plus every installed skin (e.g. 深海女仆工坊 / maid-ateli"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"er).
3. Click **Apply** on a skin → click **Refresh** when prompted → the skin
activates.
4. Click *"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"*Apply** on **Default** to restore the stock look."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Skin package protocol"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Any package is recognized as a skin when:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- it lives under the profile's `node_modules` (top-level or `@scope/name`),
- it ships a `skin.json`"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" (`id`, `name`, `package`, `accent`, `bodyAttr`,
`tagline`, optional `wiring.id` — the same fields u"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"sed by
dsh-deep-whale / dsh-web-ui skins), and
- it ships a prebuilt client bundle (`exports["./clie"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"nt"]` or `lib/client.js`)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"A market theme without `skin.json` is also recognized when:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- it has `dsh.client` and `dsh.bundle.patch`,
- its `cordis.patch.yml` contains a simple `insert` ro"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"w,
- the package name, row id, or (for immediately-loaded client bundles)
description/keywords menti"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"on theme/skin, and
- it ships a prebuilt client bundle."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## dsh-market coordination"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"When dsh-market is installed, applying a skin from this manager also:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- rewrites the same `cordis.patch.yml` managed section (boot persistence),
- updates dsh-market's `."},{"id":"p19s2","text":"dsh-market/state.json` so it cannot re-disable the
chosen skin at boot,
- unmounts stale dsh-market "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"hot mounts that would otherwise overlap the newly
applied skin, and
- syncs dsh-market's in-memory d"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"isabled state before rewriting the patch, so
the market's self-healing guard cannot immediately re-d"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"isable the skin you
just applied — no manual "use" click in the market is needed."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How switching works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Switching rewrites the managed section of the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`
(between `# --- dsh-skin-"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"manager managed ---` markers):"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- active skin → an `- insert:` row;
- every other skin → `- id: <rowId>` + `disabled: true`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Non-skin user patch rows (e.g. dsh-market) are preserved untouched."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## API"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The host half mounts three routes under `/api/skin-manager`:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Route | Method | Purpose |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `/api/skin-manager/list` | GET | List installed skins + current active id |
| `/api/skin-manager/a"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"pply` | POST | `{ id }` or `{ id: "official" }` to switch |
| `/api/skin-manager/bundle` | GET | `?i"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"d=<skinId>` serve a skin's client bundle |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The client bundle is written directly in the `__ModuleLoader__` bundle format
(the same shape tsdown"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" emits for the shipped `ui-*` packages), so no build
step is required. `lib/client.js` may `require`"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" only module-table entities
(platform seed words like `react` and registered client bundles)."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
